title: A room reclaimed
alt: A weathered room with a wooden doorway, crumbling walls, and plants growing through a window.

tiles.caption: Dark brick wall corner in dim olive light.
tiles.ekphrasis: A pier of old brick dissolves into shadow at the left edge, its mortar lines barely surfacing from the murk. Light grazes the right face as if reluctant to touch it.

tiles.caption: Stone vault and arch with stained yellowed plaster.
tiles.ekphrasis: A vault rib curves down like a seam in skin, splitting cold grey from a sickly gold wall. Dark blotches spread across the plaster like ink on wet paper.

tiles.caption: Curved stained plaster wall with dark water marks.
tiles.ekphrasis: The arch's edge is lost in a bloom of black damp that reads almost like a silhouette. A pale pillar edge cuts in from the right, out of focus.

tiles.caption: Weathered stone pillar beside a wooden frame.
tiles.ekphrasis: A worn pillar wears a block capital like a collar, moss streaking its flank. A wooden frame enters from the right, holding only more rock.

tiles.caption: Old brick wall with holes and a green streak.
tiles.ekphrasis: Rows of square holes punctuate the brick like missing teeth. A thin green stain runs down the corner, a slow vertical seep.

tiles.caption: Peeling plaster wall beside a weathered wooden door.
tiles.ekphrasis: Plaster flakes in maplike patches, ochre over grey, ending at a door bleached silver. The door's top vanishes into darkness.

tiles.caption: Wooden door edge and crumbling wall with a small hole.
tiles.ekphrasis: A single round hole stares from the stone like an eye socket. Pale dry stems reach in from the right, catching light like wire.

tiles.caption: Mossy wall with ivy and a wooden frame.
tiles.ekphrasis: Ivy climbs a rusted grate at the left edge while a thin cable loops lazily down. Blue daylight washes the plaster cold.

tiles.caption: Purple-tinted brick wall with dark horizontal bands.
tiles.ekphrasis: The brick turns bruise-colored, banded by black strips of soot or shadow. A corner fold runs down the right like a spine.

tiles.caption: Debris-strewn floor with loose wooden planks.
tiles.ekphrasis: Pebbles and dry leaves gather on a dusty threshold, a plank lying across like a forgotten step. White scraps glow at the right edge.

tiles.caption: Fallen leaves and debris on ground near a rock wall.
tiles.ekphrasis: Green and pink leaves scatter like dropped confetti over dirt and stone. A dark slab tilts in from the right corner, cutting the scene.

tiles.caption: Slanted dark panels with a rusty rod against a wall.
tiles.ekphrasis: Heavy grey slabs lean at odd angles, a rusted rod pinning them like a splint. Behind, pale wall and a wooden frame sit in thin daylight.

title: Looking at a painting
alt: A visitor seen from behind looking at a painting of books, papers, and musical instruments.

tiles.caption: Top-left corner of a painting of wooden planks against a mauve wall.
tiles.ekphrasis: Painted pine boards, knots like closed eyes, tiny nails pricking the grain. A tilted board slides in from the lower edge, and above it the dusky wall goes on unbroken.

tiles.caption: Small framed landscape hanging on painted wooden boards above papers.
tiles.ekphrasis: A picture within a picture: a misty grey landscape hangs from a brass ring on painted wood. Curling pages and an engraving crowd in from below, the edge cutting them mid-sentence.

tiles.caption: Painted wooden panel and cupboard shelves, top of a head at bottom.
tiles.ekphrasis: A black hinge holds painted boards beside a dark cabinet. From the bottom corner the crown of a real head rises, its hair clip a small intrusion into the painted world.

tiles.caption: Corner of a painting showing stacked books on a shelf.
tiles.ekphrasis: Tied books with red ribbons wait on a shadowed shelf, a quill resting across them. The canvas ends abruptly, giving way to an empty, gently lit wall.

tiles.caption: Painted crumpled papers, red figurine, and white bust on wooden boards.
tiles.ekphrasis: A crushed sheaf of paper hangs like a pale cloud over a red clay child and a blank-eyed plaster bust. A blue bow and a medallion are pinned beside them, every object posing to fool the eye.

tiles.caption: Painted letters, pen, and violin beneath a pink ribbon; hair at right.
tiles.ekphrasis: A pink strap pins letters, a sealed note, and a red pen to the boards; a printed title reads 'Le Fleau'. A curtain of real hair falls over the right edge.

tiles.caption: Back of a long-haired person in front of a painted cabinet.
tiles.ekphrasis: Long brown hair fills most of the view, straight and luminous. Behind it, painted jars and a rolled map sit in a dim cupboard.

tiles.caption: Painted shelf with leaning books, blue ribbons, and a clay jar.
tiles.ekphrasis: Gilded and worn bindings lean together, blue bows loose as if just untied. The painting stops at a soft brown wall that holds nothing.

tiles.caption: Bottom edge of a framed painting above a dark wall with user icon.
tiles.ekphrasis: The painting's lower lip casts a black shadow. Below, a grey circle with a faceless silhouette floats like a stand-in for someone.

tiles.caption: Dark shoulder and hair silhouetted below a painting's edge.
tiles.ekphrasis: A black garment swells into the frame like a cliff of shadow. Hair tips glow at the right edge.

tiles.caption: Long brown hair falling over dark clothing against a wall.
tiles.ekphrasis: Strands catch the light in fine copper lines, ending unevenly. A dark sleeve curves away into the plum-colored wall.

tiles.caption: Corner of painting over brown wall with a muted speaker icon.
tiles.ekphrasis: The frame's corner hangs in shadow while a crossed-out speaker glows below. The scene is declared silent.

title: After the celebration
alt: A candlelit dining room with patterned walls, red chairs, and colorful balloons scattered around the table.

tiles.caption: Blurred glass pane in a pale wooden frame.
tiles.ekphrasis: A smear of gold light hangs behind frosted glass, as if a room were trying to remember itself. The mullion cuts diagonally, soft and out of focus.

tiles.caption: Painted floral wall panel beside a green silk curtain.
tiles.ekphrasis: Painted leaves climb a curved panel while a glare blooms at its base, bleaching the flowers white. The chartreuse curtain falls heavy, its rings biting the rod.

tiles.caption: Crystal chandelier hanging before a tall window with green curtains.
tiles.ekphrasis: Crystals drip like frozen rain from tarnished arms, cut off mid-cascade at the frame's edge. Behind them the window is black, holding night flat against the glass.

tiles.caption: Gilded wall panels painted with birds and blossoms under ornate molding.
tiles.ekphrasis: Pink blossoms drift across gold-leaf walls that curve away from the eye. A single chandelier arm intrudes from the left, a dangling ribbon trailing beneath it.

tiles.caption: Three candle flames reflected through a glass door.
tiles.ekphrasis: Three small flames float in a haze of glass, ghost-candles in another room. The dark latch hangs like a shut eyelid at the right.

tiles.caption: White abstract sculpture on pedestal, chair with red balloon.
tiles.ekphrasis: A pale bulbous sculpture leans on its plinth like a body folding into itself. Below, a red balloon presses against a chairback, glossy and patient.

tiles.caption: Candlelit dining table with glasses and red poinsettia before a window.
tiles.ekphrasis: The table is set and abandoned, glasses catching thin candle halos while a poinsettia burns red at its center. The window behind gives back only darkness.

tiles.caption: Framed landscape painting above chairs against floral painted walls.
tiles.ekphrasis: A framed woodland sits askew against painted trees, a forest inside a forest. Red velvet chairbacks crowd the foreground like a waiting audience.

tiles.caption: Blurred white wainscoting with a balloon edge at right.
tiles.ekphrasis: Molding lines slide diagonally in soft focus, all cream and shadow. In the lower corner, a yellow curve of balloon peeks in.

tiles.caption: Colorful balloons along a wall beside a chair on a patterned rug.
tiles.ekphrasis: Balloons gather along the baseboard like stranded fruit, and one white sphere hides under the chair. The rug's dense pattern drinks the low light.

tiles.caption: Chair legs and balloons under a dining table in dim light.
tiles.ekphrasis: Beneath the table it is twilight, carved legs standing among fallen balloons. A pale yellow one glows faintly, as if lit from within.

tiles.caption: Chairs on a rug with balloons and a speaker icon overlay.
tiles.ekphrasis: A gray speaker symbol floats over the scene, promising a sound no one hears. A white balloon is half-cut at the bottom edge; a blue one hides behind a chair.
